content: Kitenie tehɨwemete
Kitenie tehɨwemete kememɨte'u'uitɨarie:
Kurehe nuiwarimama hetsiemieme: Metseremiyaxi Kurehe nu'aya, 'Atsahapi nuiwarieyatsie mieme.
Metseremiyaxi niwemama mepakɨ: Matɨari mieme Tsakariyaxi, hutarieka mieme Keriyaheri, hairieka mieme Tsewariyaxi, naurieka mieme Katinieri
'auxɨwirieka mieme 'Erami 'ataxewirieka mieme Kuhanahani, 'atahutarieka mieme 'Erihuhenahi.
'Uweri-'Erumi niwemama mepakɨ: Mexɨakame mieme Tsemahiyaxi, hutarieka mieme Kutsawari, hairieka mieme Kuha, naurieka mieme Tsakaxi, 'auxɨwirieka mieme Natanaheri,
'ataxewirieka mieme 'Amiheri, 'atahutarieka mieme 'Itsakaxi. 'atahairieka mieme Pehuritahi. Kakaɨyari 'Uweri-'Erumi 'aixɨa kaniuyurieni tɨɨri waɨkawa mɨwarayexeiyakɨ.
'Uweri-'Erumi nu'aya Tsemahiyaxi mɨkɨta tɨɨri pɨwarayexei, mɨkɨ mepakɨ yutɨɨriyama wahetsiemieme memanuyetekai, teɨteri memɨkamama mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai.
Tsemahiyaxi niwemama mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai, 'Utini, Xapahiri, 'Uweri, 'Eritsawari meta wa'iwama 'Erihu meta Tsamakiyaxi, mɨkɨ yunaitɨ teɨteri memɨkamama mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai.

Mɨkɨ yunaitɨ 'Uweri-'Erumi mepɨnuiwarimamatɨkai. Mɨkɨ meta waniwema meta wa'iwama teɨteri memɨkamama memɨtɨrɨkawi mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai 'uximayatsikakɨ. Yunaitɨ haika tewiyari heimana huta mepɨyupaɨmekai, 'Uweri-'Erumi nuiwarimama.
Metseremiyaxi niwemama meta 'iwamama meyunaitɨ, tamamata heimana 'atahaika mepɨyupaɨmekai, mɨkɨ teɨteri memɨkamama mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai.
Kutsa niwemama, Merari nuiwarieya hetsiemieme, mepɨhɨkɨ Tsimɨri, wa'ukiyari matɨa (tsepa mɨkamexɨakametɨkai, peru 'ukiyarieya manuyeka kaneyeitɨani),
hutarieka mieme Kirikiyaxi patɨa, hairieka mieme Tewariyaxi patɨa meta naurieka Tsakariyaxi. Mɨkɨ yunaitɨ Kutsa niwemama meta 'iwamama mepakɨ tamamata heimana haika.
Merikɨte mɨpaɨ mekateniu'uitɨarieni kitenie tehɨwemete, memanuyetei meta wa'iwama, Yawé tukieyata memɨte'uximayakakɨ.
Kitenie kepauka memɨtetahɨnikekai mepupitɨarie 'inɨarikɨ yuxexuitɨ nuiwarite 'amemɨyumate meta 'etsimemɨyumate yunaitɨ.
'Inɨarikɨ kememɨte'upitɨarie, Tseremiyaxi pɨtiunakixɨ 'itupari tau manatineika hepa meuwie, meta nu'aya Tsakariyaxi, mɨtimaiwekai mɨ'ɨxatsitametɨkai, pɨtiunakixɨ 'itupari tayetatsie meuwie.
'Uweri-'Erumi pɨtiunakixɨ kitenie tahetɨa hepatsie meuwie, meta niwemama mepɨhɨritɨarie 'ikwaite mɨtiuyepine tukita timieme.

Tsupini meta Kutsa matɨa Tsareketi kitenieyari mekateniunake, tau makayuyuipike hepatsie, huye teikɨmana meutiyɨnetsie. Yuxexuitɨ nuiwarite kemɨ'ane kitenieyaritsie memɨte'unakixɨ mana mekatenihɨkaitɨni yayupapaɨmetɨ:

Xexuime tukaritsie me'ataxewitɨ rewitsixi tau manatineika hepa meukitenietsie mepu'uwekai, yunaukatɨ tayeta hepatsie, meta yunaukatɨ tahetɨa hepatsie, meta yuhuhutatɨ xexuime 'ikwaite mɨtiuyepitɨkatsie mepɨtehɨkai.
Takwa tau makayuyuipike hepa mukumatsie yuhutatɨ mepɨtehɨkai rewitsixi meta yunaukatɨ mɨkɨ huyeyari 'utɨma.
Mɨpaɨ mekateniu'uitɨarieni kitenie tehɨwemete Kure meta Merari wanuiwarima.
Piinite mɨraye'atɨka tehɨwemete
Hipatɨta rewitsixi mepɨte'ɨhɨritɨarie tukita timieme piini mɨraye'atɨka meta mɨtipatsietɨka Kakaɨyari hetsie timieme muwa mɨtiuyepitɨkatsie.
Rarani Keritsuni punuiwarieyatɨkai, Kehieri manuyeka kanayani Rarani nuiwarimama wahetsie.
Kehieri niwemama Tsetani meta Kuheri, mɨkɨ mepɨhɨritɨarie piinite mɨraye'atɨka Yawé tukita timieme.

Tsewuheri, Keritsuni nuiwarieya Muitsexi nu'aya, mɨkɨ tumini hɨwemete wa'ukiyari pɨhɨkɨtɨkai yunaime wahetsiemieme, 'Amirani nuiwarimama, 'Itsaxi nuiwarimama, Hewuruni nuiwarimama meta 'Utsiheri nuiwarimama.
'Eriyetsexi nuiwarimama kememɨte'unuiwaxɨ, Xekawiyaxi, Kitsariyaxi, Kurani, Tsikɨri meta Tserumiti.

Tserumiti meta 'iwamama mepuhɨritɨarie piinite mɨtipatsietɨka hipatɨ memɨteyetua, ti'aitame Rawiri, meta nuiwarite wa'ukiyarima, meta kuyaxi xeimiriyari meta xeitsienituyari tewa'aitɨwamete meta hipatɨ kuyaxi tewa'aitɨwamete.
Mɨkɨ mepɨteyetuakai piinitɨarika kuyaxa memɨteha'iwakai, kɨmana Yawé tukieya 'aixɨa muku'itɨarienikɨ.
Tserumiti meta 'iwamama mepɨhɨritɨariekai, Tsamuheri Kakaɨyari niukameya mɨtiyetua, Tsahuri Kihitsi nu'aya mɨtiyetua, meta 'Awinexi Nexi nu'aya meta Kuhawi Tsariwiya nu'aya memɨteyetua.
Kenaniyaxi meta niwemama, 'Itsaxi memɨnuiwarimama, mɨkɨ mepɨ'itsukatetɨkai ti'aitame mepɨparewiekai 'aixɨa mepɨte'akayuruwakai naime 'uximatɨarikatsie 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie.

Katsawiyaxi meta maremama, mɨkɨ Hewuruni nuiwarimama mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai, xeimiriyari heimana 'atahuta tsienituyari mepɨkɨkɨtɨkai teɨteri memɨkamama. Mɨkɨ Kurutani 'anutaɨye tau makayuyuipike hepa 'ixaheritsixi watsata mepɨte'uximayakai Yawé hetsiemieme meta ti'aitame hetsiemieme.

Hewuruni nuiwarimama wa'ukiyari Keriyaxi pɨhɨkɨtɨkai. Huta tewiyari wiyari Rawiri ti'aitakaku, kaneutixeiyariexɨani Hewuruni nuiwarieya xapayari, mekaniutaxeiyarieni Katsexi kiekariyaritsie Karaha kwieyaritsie teɨteri memɨkamama.

Mɨkɨ teɨteri memɨkamama mekaniyupaɨmekaitɨni huta miriyari heimana 'atahuta tsienituyari (2.700). Rawiri ti'aitame kaniwaruhɨritɨani memɨte'uximayakakɨ Xuweni nuiwarimama, Kahari nuiwarimama, meta Manatsexi nuiwarimama hixɨapa memɨ'axe wahetsiemieme, tinaimekɨ Kakaɨyari hetsiemieme meta ti'aitame hetsie timieme.
